jobs.occupation: Principal Expert Factory Physics & Fab Performance (f/m/div) (Wirtschaftsingenieur/in)
jobs.employer_name: Infineon Technologies Dresden AG & Co. KG
jobs.description:
As a Principal Expert Factory Physics & Fab Performance (f/m/div), you will play a key role in shaping the performance of one of Europe's most advanced semiconductor manufacturing sites. By transforming manufacturing data into actionable insights, you will influence critical decisions on productivity, cycle time and capacity development. Your expertise will directly support the ramp-up of Infineon's €5 billion Smart Power Fab while helping to shape the future of Industrial Engineering in Dresden.

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

- Serve as the Factory Physics authority for the Dresden site, developing models that translate manufacturing complexity into actionable insights for throughput, cycle time, variability and bottleneck management
- Lead high-impact productivity programs, from identifying optimization potential to driving implementation and sustainable business results
- Provide expert guidance on complex Industrial Engineering challenges and act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders across Operations, Planning, Technology, Equipment Engineering and Finance
- Define and continuously enhance local performance benchmarks, assessment methods and analytical approaches to support data-driven decision-making
- Strengthen the Industrial Engineering network through active collaboration and best-practice exchange with colleagues across Infineon's Front-End manufacturing sites

Your Profile
As Principal Expert Factory Physics & Fab Performance (f/m/div), you own the Factory Physics competence for the Dresden site. You model the fab as a physical system, identify the real bottlenecks and bring recommendations to decision — not to filing. Your work is directly visible: in the ramp decisions of the Smart Power Fab and in the strategic roadmap of the IE cluster. You build where others optimize and shape how Industrial Engineering in Dresden will make impact over the coming years.
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

- Master's or Diploma degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, Operations Research or a comparable field; PhD is a plus
- 6–10 years of relevant experience in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Science or Operations Research — with demonstrable Factory Physics application in a technology-intensive high-volume manufacturing environment
- Strong expertise in Factory Physics methods, including throughput, variability, bottleneck and cycle-time analysis
- Proficiency in SQL, Python or R and common BI tools for data-driven decision-making
- Experience leading cross-functional program teams with 7–8-digit business impact and confidently engaging stakeholders up to senior management
- Hands-on experience with fab analytics and simulation tools such as Smart OEE, AutoSched, D-Simcon or AnyLogic (nice to have)
- Fluent German and English language skills, both written and spoken (B2-Niveau)

Contact:
Nicole Hippmann, LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/in/nicole-hippmann-01b036172/)

Optimize. Innovate. Deliver. Join us in redefining manufacturing excellence. As a (Senior) Supervisor Maintenance Automation on our Manufacturing and Operations team, find yourself in a high-tech world where silicon wafers evolve into cutting-edge products. Are you in?

Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role

- Disciplinary and functional leadership of the shift team, including the development and coaching of employees and apprentices
- Responsibility for transport systems and automation equipment in the 200 mm and 300 mm manufacturing facilities

You are able to effectively communicate the company’s strategic direction and create and foster a trust-based work environment that encourages learning from mistakes. In addition, you promote an open culture of communication within your area of responsibility, where questions and information can be shared freely and are viewed as opportunities for continuous improvement.

- Strong knowledge of automation systems and control room operations

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

You lead the commodity agenda for a commodity for Large Steam and Syncon products. From your base in Bucharest or Mülheim, you orchestrate the commodity circle, align closely with Engineering, Quality, and Operations, and turn market insight into resilient sourcing strategies and supplier agreements that secure capacity, reduce risk, and deliver measurable cost and sustainability impact. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Developing and implementing the Commodity Strategy for Large Steam and Syncon portfolio in alignment with Global Commodity Strategy
* Lead the Commodity Circle and drive the end-to-end strategic procurement cycle: market analysis & scouting, should cost insights, negotiation planning, eSourcing events, award proposals, and sourcing board preparations
* Secure capacity and supply resilience via frame contracts, price lists, and multi sourcing strategies; identify and mitigate risks (e.g., tariff exposure, single source, capacity constraints) and ensure continuity for critical Large Steam and Syncon demand
* Deliver measurable value (CNI/savings, total cost improvements, inventory and cash objectives) and maintain transparent KPIs and spend dashboards for your area
* Drive early supplier involvement with Engineering and SQD to accelerate NPI/continuous improvement, quality robustness, and manufacturability—translating field and supply market feedback into actionable design-to-value measures
* Manage strategic supplier relationships: performance reviews, joint improvement roadmaps, and executive governance with top suppliers in EMEA and beyond

What You Bring

* Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain/Procurement, or Business—plus professional experience in direct material commodity management or category management in an industrial/manufacturing setting
* Familiarity with heavy industry products. Experience turning technical specs into sourcing strategies is key
* Supplier market analysis & scouting, cost modelling/should cost, competitive tendering, fact-based negotiations, contracting (frame agreements/price lists), and risk management
* Proven ability to lead cross functional commodity teams (Commodity Circle) and influence at multiple levels, internally and at suppliers
* Proficiency with ERP/MRP and eSourcing platforms; comfort with KPI dashboards and data driven decisions. (Experience within Siemens Energy procurement frameworks is a plus.) 
* Professional fluency in German & Englisch required for stakeholder and supplier interactions; Willingness to travel (~10–20%) for supplier visits and cross site collaboration

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder under very attractive employee conditions
* Under our motto #BetterTogether, we offer flexible and remote working options, as well as modern office spaces that foster collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We offer various programs and initiatives to support self-directed learning and developmentTo support work-life balance, we offer a wide range of benefits, such as flexible working time models, childcare options at many locations, trial part-time arrangements, and sabbaticals
* We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

service providers in Germany and one of the fastest-growing staffing

With more than 120 locations across Germany and Europe, we are
committed to establishing flexible staffing solutions and making a
positive contribution to the regional labor market.

Help us continue to expand this successful business model and apply
today!

As one of the most successful and innovative personnel service
providers in Germany, we are currently looking for a Lead Technical
Facility Services (m/f/d) on behalf of our renowned client in Dresden,
starting as soon as possible, as part of a direct placement.

 

As a Lead Technical Facility Services (m/f/d), you will play a key
technical role in supporting international customers. You will be
responsible for installing, commissioning, qualifying and optimizing
advanced technical systems and providing hands-on technical support at
customer sites.

Working closely with engineering teams, you will use your technical
expertise to ensure excellent system performance and contribute to the
continuous improvement and development of products.

The position involves extensive travel throughout Europe, as well as a
willingness to participate in product training programs in the United
States.

 

Your responsibilities

- Install, commission and qualify abatement systems at customer sites
across Europe
- Deliver certified customer training for Cyclone and Encompass
systems
- Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues
- Provide expert technical support directly at customer sites
- Conduct field testing and collect system performance data
- Support process and product optimization initiatives
- Collaborate closely with engineering teams on product development,
testing and continuous improvement projects
- Ensure compliance with all company safety, quality and operational
standards

Your qualifications

- Degree or technical qualification in Electrical Engineering,
Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related technical field
- Extensive professional experience as a Field Service Engineer /
Service Engineer in an international environment
- Ideally, experience within the semiconductor, process or high-tech
manufacturing industry
- Strong troubleshooting and technical diagnostic skills
- Ability to read and interpret electrical, mechanical and pneumatic
schematics
- Experience using test equipment, measuring instruments and hand
tools
- Fluent German and English
- Excellent communication and training skills
- Willingness to travel extensively throughout Europe
- Willingness to participate in product training programs in the
United States

 

What the position offers

- Permanent employment
- International and technically challenging working environment
- Opportunity to work within the high-tech / semiconductor industry
- Varied assignments at international customer sites
- Close cooperation with engineering and development teams
- Opportunity to contribute to product optimization and technical
development
- International product training, including training programs in the
United States
 

 

How to Apply:

If you would like to apply directly, you are welcome to send us your
CV by email or submit your details via our online application. When
applying online, you can simply upload your CV after entering your
contact details. It only takes 1 minute. Why not apply today?

Welcome to the global management consultancy of BASF! We focus on strategic projects that drive the effective transformation of our businesses. Our teams work on a broad range of topics such as sustainability, organizational development, efficiency projects, M&A, and profitable growth through all types of innovation.
We put people first: We are proud of our strong team spirit, and we cherish diversity. Become part of a great international team where your hands-on approach and desire to leave an impact are truly valued. Together, let's create new ideas and offer the best solutions to our customers.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

- As Senior Project Lead (m/f/d) you collaborate with colleagues on complex strategy consulting projects and provide impactful solutions for businesses and functions across BASF.
- You identify potential improvements in each project and advise the management team competently and empathetically.
- From Day 1, you apply your skills and contribute your ideas to ongoing projects.
- You communicate clearly and openly with all parties involved throughout all project phases.
- Our end-to-end consulting services allow you to accompany a project from start to finish.
- You enjoy top management visibility by working with BASF Executives globally on a wide range of strategic high-priority projects with sustainable impact.

Our projects cover the fields of Innovation & Growth, Marketing & Sales, Organizational Excellence, and Post-Merger Integration/Carve Out. For an overview about our practice groups see here.

- excellent communication skills in English; German is a plus

BLISSAIR, based in Bocholt, Germany, is an aviation company, providing customized air transport solutions and aviation services.

BLISSAIR stands for safe, fast, and comfortable private air travel worldwide, delivered through our own aircraft fleet as well as an extensive network of partner aircraft.

Our facilities in Bocholt have recently been expanded to include a CAE Full-Flight Simulator for the King Air B200 equipped with a Pro Line 21 cockpit. A second simulator is already in the planning stage.

The simulator provides a highly realistic representation of the aircraft and is certified to the highest qualification standard, Level D. This gives BLISSAIR a unique market position, as it is the only simulator of its kind in Europe.

To support the ongoing maintenance and operation of this simulator, we are looking for an enthusiastic aviation-minded team player to join us as soon as possible.

- Completed vocational training as an Aircraft Electronics Technician, Electronics Technician, Mechatronics Technician, a comparable technical qualification, or a degree in an engineering or technical field.
- Good computer skills, particularly with Windows operating systems and older computer hardware
- Good IT skills, basic network setup and understanding of network protocols.
- Familiarity with technologies such as RS-232, Ethernet, Fibre Optics and Microcontrollers.

- Ability to work independently with a high level of personal responsibility.
- Knowledge of C++ programming language and experience in the aviation industry are an advantage.
- Fluent in spoken and written english
- Quick learner with strong teamwork skills, initiative, and enthusiasm.
- Strong interest in technical systems and aviation industry

Your Responsibilities

- Work as part of the simulator maintenance team.
- Independently perform maintenance and servicing of simulator hardware, including quality checks.
- Provide technical support during customer training operations.
- Analyze and diagnose faults, carry out repairs.
- Document maintenance activities, inspections, and quality checks.

What We Offer

- A friendly working environment in a small team with an open, collaborative culture and flat hierarchies.
- A responsible and varied role with exciting technical challenges.
- The opportunity to work on a unique Level D King Air B200 simulator—the only one of its kind in Europe.
- A positive workplace atmosphere and modern facilities.
- The chance to contribute to internal process improvements and help plan and implement the company's second simulator.

Introduction

INM is an internationally leading centre for interdisciplinary research on (bio)hybrid materials, and their exploitation in materials-based solutions for a sustainable world with increasing digitalization and medical needs. Our research integrates materials chemistry, biological processes, physical analysis, and process engineering. We aim for leadership in the fields of opto-interactive, electro-integrative and bio-intelligent material systems. In these areas, we actively seize opportunities to transfer our scientific results into materials-driven innovation.

The INM research group, Bioprogrammable Materials, is looking for an enthusiastic Post-Doctoral Researcher with experience in microbial biotechnology and adaptive laboratory evolution (ALE). We combine synthetic biology, microbial engineering and sustainable materials research to develop innovative solutions for industrial and environmental challenges. We are seeking to fill a 2-year funded Post-Doctoral Researcher position as part of an Industrially-aligned European project developing sustainable biobased coatings. The role at INM focuses on identifying and ehancingmicrobes capable of degrading the polymeric coatings, thereby enabling future circularity and end-of-life strategies.

Identify microbes capable of degrading bio-based polymeric materials
Establish screening platforms to evaluate microbial degradation performance
Apply adaptive laboratory evolution (ALE) to improve degradation efficiency and substrate utilization
Characterize evolved strains using microbiological and molecular biology techniques
Collaborate closely with industrial and academic project partners
Contribute to project reporting, scientific publications and conference presentations
Actively participate in the research activities of the group
We are seeking a person with a doctoral degree in biotechnology, biochemistry, microbiology or related fields, with practical experience in adaptive lab evolution. The candidate will be part of an international, multi-disciplinary team in which English is the primary language of communication and reporting. Since we work on application-oriented research, candidates with entrepreneurial interests are appreciated.

A 2-year E13 TV-L 100% contract.
A dynamic, interdisciplinary, and international research environment with excellent, state-of-the-art infrastructure.
A cooperative, friendly and supportive environment, with plenty of opportunities to interact with other researchers, also outside the team and the institute.
The opportunity for training to support high-quality research and to further develop your profile.

Neuronal exocytosis is a highly regulated process that enables the rapid release of neurotransmitters from synaptic vesicles. Central to this process is the controlled assembly of SNARE protein complexes, which drive membrane fusion and are regulated by a network of associated proteins. The PhD project will investigate the structural and molecular mechanisms underlying SNARE complex assembly and function in membrane-like environments. A particular focus will be placed on the development and characterization of membrane-mimetic systems, including lipid nanodiscs and synthetic copolymers, to study SNARE complexes and their regulatory proteins under increasingly native-like conditions. Cryo-electron microscopy will be combined with complementary biochemical and biophysical approaches to characterize these systems at the molecular level.
The project offers the opportunity to work in an interdisciplinary structural biology environment at Forschungszentrum Jülich, with access to expertise in cryo-EM, NMR spectroscopy and X-ray crystallography. Cryo-EM studies will be conducted at the state-of-the-art facilities of the Ernst Ruska-Centre (ER-C) at Forschungszentrum Jülich. The expertise in NMR spectroscopy and macromolecular crystallography at IBI-7 offers further opportunities for complementary structural and biophysical characterization. This combination of methods will enable the candidate to address biological questions from different structural perspectives and to develop a broad expertise in modern structural biology. We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with:

A Master’s degree in biochemistry, molecular biology, structural biology, or a related field

Strong practical experience in protein biochemistry, including recombinant protein expression and purification
Previous hands-on experience with cryo-electron microscopy and/or cryo-EM sample preparation
Interest in membrane proteins, protein-protein interactions and structural biology
Ability to work independently as well as in an interdisciplinary research team
Good communication skills in English
